# Arnav Dashaputra

> Data Scientist and Full-Stack Engineer based in New Jersey. Builds predictive
> pricing models in production, cloud-native document infrastructure, and
> software projects spanning data science, machine learning, and web engineering.

This site is a single-page portfolio. The sections below describe what it holds,
so an agent does not need to render the JavaScript application to summarize it.

## Current roles

- Data Scientist, AmTrust Financial Services, Inc. (Princeton, NJ) — since January 2026. End-to-end predictive pricing models for flagship commercial lines.
- Senior Product Engineer, Butterfly AI Tech Solutions (remote) — since November 2025. Cloud-native document infrastructure for regulated industries; second engineer.
- Sr Instructor, Code Ninjas Bridgewater (Bridgewater, NJ) — since August 2025. Lessons on advanced topics in computer science, game development, 3D modeling, and AI-assisted coding. Previously Center Director there, 2022–2025.

## Background

- B.S. Computer Science, Rutgers University, 2021–2024.
- Prior engineering roles: Lead Software Engineer at medem, Data Engineer at Got Users, Full Stack Engineer at Phillipvn Photography LLC, Technology Labs Consultant at Rutgers New Brunswick Computing Services.

## Focus areas

Data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, Python, SQL, React,
TypeScript, AWS, and cloud architecture.
